title: Size convention
statement:
Fix Grothendieck universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal V$ containing the schemes
and coefficient rings under consideration. Replace every site by a
$\mathcal V$-small skeleton within the chosen bound. Derived categories and
filtered colimits are formed in $\mathcal V$.

lean.note: A metatheoretic size convention, no definiendum: it fixes universes U ∈ V, V-small skeleta of sites, and the universe in which derived categories and filtered colimits are formed. Lean has no counterpart object: universe polymorphism (explicit universe levels u, v on Scheme, sites and categories) plays the role of the universes, and the Mathlib facts that stand in are CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall / SmallModel (small skeleta), CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isGrothendieckAbelian_of_essentiallySmall and HasDerivedCategory (derived categories of sheaves existing in the larger universe), HasColimitsOfSize (filtered colimits). A citer states its universe hypotheses directly.
